changeinfo.changes:
NOTE: This is an extremely large update.
  • Fog now displays properly in all levels where it is present
  • Adjusted lighting values on all player craft and some capital ships to increase visibility
  • AI now properly targets and attacks player character
  • Text clarity improved game wide
  • Animations adjusted for all cinematics and NPCs
  • Cockpit view and assets are completely redesigned to be more readable
  • Purchased equipment is now stored by ship, not globally
  • Pilot Hand in cockpit can now be toggled through options menu
  • Background NPCs have been added to many parts of the USF Midway
  • There is now a "START MISSION" button available in the USF Midway Landing Bay, which will allow a player to skip to the start of the mission
  • All trophies are now awarded properly
  • Ship costs have been adjusted to more accurately reflect their worth in game
  • Mission Pause screen and Tactical Screens now accurately reflect current CPs earned
  • Max ship speeds have been increased by 1.5x, afterburner max speed increased by 3x
  • Quick match option has been added to Multiplayer options - it will choose the next lobby with players present. If there are no players present, it will create a "Free For All" game
  • Confirm dialogs added for purchases
  • Braking has been adjusted globally to compensate for new faster speeds - braking is now 2.5x faster than it was previously
  • Purchase button added for ship and equipment screens
  • User-set audio sound levels now change properly when loading game
  • Subtitles now fit within box properly and are more readable
  • AI ships now behave better in the Rhea Cave (Mission 05)
  • The lighting on the cave is now significantly improved, and the texture has been brightened to make it more visible
  • Ship yaw, pitch and speed values have been adjusted to give different ships more of a distinctive feel
  • Targetting now steps through bogies according to distance
  • Y-axis invert works properly
  • Two cinematics added
  • User can now switch functions between left and right control sticks in options
  • Player can now choose a color for their purchased ships in single player mode
  • Player can now choose a color for their chosen ships in all multiplayer modes
  • Optimization of frame rate in all parts of game
  • General bug fixes
